name: @furlpay/furl-token
description: FURL — the FurlPay ecosystem's USD-denominated payment currency (intended to operate as its stablecoin) on Solana. Token-2022 mint config, devnet-first launch scripts, and deterministic supply/allocation logic. Builds the on-chain token; the peg/reserves/redemption of a production stablecoin are separate infrastructure.
